perspectives.name: discovery-weak-signals
observations: Cheniere raised 2026 adjusted EBITDA guidance to $7.9-$8.4B and DCF guidance to $5.3-$5.8B after Q2; it tightened production forecast to 53-54 mtpa.
CCL Stage 3 Midscale Train 6 reached substantial completion in June; the IR news index reports full Stage 3 substantial completion and the 5,000th LNG cargo on August 31.

perspectives.name: expectations-execution
observations: Higher guidance plus sequential train completion supports execution, but expansion economics still depend on construction discipline, approvals, LNG spreads/contracts and feedgas availability.

contradictions: Six-month 2026 net loss of $0.43B coexisted with $4.14B adjusted EBITDA, highlighting derivative/noncash/accounting volatility versus operating cash economics.
unknowns: final economics/timing of pending CCL and SPL expansions

lineage.searchStrategy: bounded primary-source acquisition from issuer IR and current results
